carbs.source_notes: Both raw Atlantic salmon records report available carbohydrate 0 g/100 g as sugar plus starch (MI0181); components are authoritative logical-zero estimates (source 50), not measured zeros. Applied to plain fresh raw salmon as a category estimate; species is unspecified. Edible flesh without skin/bones; source classifications include chilling/freezing.

vitamin_d.source_notes: Unknown: Norwegian documentation defines vitamin D as D3; the raw salmon values do not establish the required unweighted D2+D3+25-OH-D3 sum. A salmon study measuring D3/25-OH-D3 was located, but its full evidence was inaccessible and a compatible D2-inclusive result was not verified. No missing component was assumed zero.

vitamin_e.source_notes: Unknown: Norwegian documentation maps its vitamin E to alpha-tocopherol. NEVO 2025 requires alpha + 0.40*beta + 0.10*gamma + 0.01*delta tocopherol (p.29). Complete matched raw-salmon component data or a verified NEVO-equivalent total was not obtained; alpha alone was not substituted.

vitamin_k.source_notes: Unknown: the Norwegian raw-salmon records do not report vitamin K. A paper, Menaquinone Content of Cheese (2018), includes salmon and K1/MK4-MK10, but full-text access was blocked and species, preparation and fresh edible portion could not be verified. K1 alone or a cooked-salmon MK4 value cannot establish the requested total.

folate.source_notes: Exploratory category proxy: equal midpoint of 7 ug food folate (farmed Atlantic, source 321b) and 13 ug (wild Atlantic, source 20, itself estimated). For plain unfortified fish, natural food folate converts 1:1 to DFE per NIH. Range 7-13 is these two record values, not a population interval. Species/farming shares and fresh-only data are unavailable; sources classify chilling/freezing.

omega_3.source_notes: Exploratory category proxy: equal midpoint of reported 2.6 g (farmed Atlantic) and 2.1 g (wild Atlantic) per 100 g edible raw flesh. Both records explicitly define total cis n-3 PUFA, not EPA+DHA. Range 2.1-2.6 is the two rounded record values, not a population interval. No species/farming weights are supplied; Pacific salmon is unrepresented and source preservation includes chilling/freezing.
